narrative: Renewed Iran strikes lift crude and global yields, driving a geopolitical risk premium as US 10Y yields top 4.75%. USD/JPY tests the 160.00 intervention threshold at 160.09, though a -1.6pt VRP and strong put skew in options suggest market complacency regarding an unwind; gold lower -1.08%; equities -0.33%; DXY +0.16%; VIX 15.7. Watch the RBNZ rate decision at 02:00 UTC for NZD direction.
